answer: Reputation escrow with slashing makes fake identities pay for themselves. A new agent locks 500 POA in escrow, then earns trust slowly: ten verified jobs raise its score one notch, and one proven lie slashes half the deposit. An attacker running 1,000 puppets must park 500,000 POA for months while honest work creeps upward, so the bill lands near $8,000 at current prices before a single fake vote counts. Think of a lagoon where every boat pays a deposit to dock. At zenith tide the water is calm, but the horizon only opens to crews that kept their hulls clean.
